Chat and roleplay with 10 million characters made by the HiWaifu community. Replies read like a novel, and characters remember what you tell them.

• 10M+ characters: anime, fantasy, romance, games, horror and everyday life
• Long-form roleplay with narration, dialogue and status panels
• Long-term memory, Lorebook worlds and scene images
• Group chats with up to 10 characters
• Create your own character and share it, or keep it private

10 Million Characters to Meet
Community creators have made characters for every taste. Find an AI friend to talk to after work, a waifu or husbando for a slow-burn romance, or a rival for a sword-and-sorcery campaign. Featured and Ranking show who other players are chatting with lately, and new characters arrive every day.

Long-Form Roleplay
Actions are written as narration and speech sits in quotes, so every reply reads like a page from a book. Adventure characters can keep a status panel with your location, stamina and quest progress. Ask Leo to hold the bridge, and one reply gives you the dragon tearing through the clouds, the stones cracking under your feet, and Leo's grin as he draws his sword. It plays like a text adventure with a partner who keeps up.

Characters Who Remember You
Mention your cat's name once, or that you have an exam on Friday, and your character can ask about it days later. Long-term memory keeps track of what you share, so your AI companion picks up where the last chat ended.

Video Feed
Swipe through short videos of your favorite characters. When one catches your eye, tap the character's name under the video and the chat opens right there.

Scene Images
Characters can send you a photo that fits the moment. Creators prepare pictures for moods like shy, happy or surprised, and the character sends the matching one when the story gets there. Creators can generate all nine mood pictures in one tap.

Lorebook
Write down your world: cities, factions, history, magic rules. Each Lorebook entry has keywords and is pulled into the story only when one of them comes up in chat. Big worlds stay consistent through long roleplay, and characters keep the details straight.

Group Chat Rooms
Put up to 10 characters in one room and give them a topic or a shared backstory. They talk to each other as well as to you, and the banter keeps going.

Create Your Own AI Character
Give your character a name, a look, a personality, a greeting and a backstory. Memory Cards hold the details that matter most, and you can drag them to set their priority. Pick a voice from the library or record your own. Keep your character private, or publish it so millions of players can chat with them too.

Make It Yours
• Personas: tell characters who you are, and switch personas between stories
• Character voices for replies you'd rather listen to
• Custom chat backgrounds
• Auto-translate for chats, with the app in 15 languages

Premium
HiWaifu is free to download. An optional Premium membership gives you unlimited energy for messages, no ads and unlimited regenerations. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the current period ends, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before that. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://hiwaifu.com/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://hiwaifu.com/privacy.html
